name: Aviation Ops Toolkit
author: Luís Cavaco
_how_to_add_a_module: ui.js (wiring). Add an entry below and one to TOOLS in shell-core.js.
Move an entry to "disabled" to switch a module off; the files stay put.
_variants: python3 build.py --only recon    just that module, as its own file
A variant pulls in the module's own files plus whatever it declares in
"needs" — so a standalone builder still gets the validation engine.
_order: 2. core         — engine, examples, storage, crypto, shared UI helpers
4. module ui    — binds DOM ids, so it comes last
